html:
Ba Na has long been an attractive destination, because of its beautiful landscapes and many unique festivals. However, if this is your first time visiting Ba Na, you will definitely wonder which season to travel to Ba Na to join the festival, or immerse yourself in the space of blooming tulips. Therefore, today Vietlook Travel will share with you the most complete and concise experience of traveling to Ba Na.

Coming to Ba Na, visitors will feel the climate of 4 seasons in 1 day, a beautiful check-in point, no matter what angle you stand from, you will capture beautiful pictures for yourself, not only that, Ba Na is also the place where many exciting festivals take place, many entertainment areas, shopping, or culinary areas with strong Asian-European flavors.

Ba Na is located in An Son village, Hoa Ninh commune, Hoa Vang district, Da Nang city and about 25km from the center of Da Nang city, where there is a poetic landscape with clouds surrounding the mountain top, will bring you the most perfect experiences during your vacation.

If you have the opportunity to travel to Da Nang, you should definitely visit Ba Na to feel the natural beauty, immerse yourself in the fresh air, and participate in many interesting games, and experience an adventure in the clouds, and experience the cable car to enjoy the moments floating on the clouds, watching the scenery of Da Thanh from above.

If you are a thrill-seeker, visit Fantasy Park, an indoor amusement park so you can play any season of the year, with many exciting games suitable for all ages. In addition, visit Le Jardin D’Amour flower garden, Debay wine cellar, Linh Ung pagoda, … and enjoy delicious food at the restaurants right on top of Ba Na.

When is the best time to travel to Ba Na?

Although Ba Na Hills is home to many famous landmarks and many festivals and events, the climate in Ba Na is relatively mild. Coming here, visitors can feel the climate of 4 seasons in 1 day, rainy mornings, sunny noons, and foggy afternoons, very convenient for visitors to go sightseeing.

To avoid being affected by fog, visitors should travel to Ba Na from April to September, at this time the weather is less rainy and sunny, very convenient for visitors to sightsee, if you want to immerse yourself in the beauty of the tulip festival, you should travel to Ba Na in the spring from January to March, if you want to immerse yourself in the space of Ba Na in winter, you should travel to Ba Na from October to December, this is also the time when Ba Na holds a vibrant Christmas Eve.

Means of transportation to the top of Ba Na

1. Go to Ba Na Hills by bus

From Da Nang city to the top of Ba Na, visitors choose public transportation by bus, the bus stop is right in the center, visitors will take the bus to Ba Na,if traveling on a tour Da Nang – Ba Na, rent a private car, or if traveling in a group, you should rent a private car for convenience.

2. Go to Ba Na by cable car

This is the most popular means of transport for tourists when traveling to Ba Na. The modern Ba Na cable car system will bring you the most wonderful feeling, from the cable car you can admire the poetic Ba Na scenery.

3. Ba Na Mountain Train

From Debay station, move to Debay ancient wine cellar, Le Jardin d’amour flower garden, Linh Ung pagoda, you can admire the scenery from the train, you can admire the majestic mountains, with a peaceful space that will bring you a feeling of excitement.

In addition, you can experience the view of Ba Na at night, at Beer Plaza restaurant, enjoy while admiring the scenery, with a European-style night party, and admire the sparkling performance, a romantic and magical space in the cold weather on the top of the mountain.
